claims.claim: Ps5 console fat uk used with 1 pad
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a white PlayStation console and a controller, but do not show the exact model/version (e.g., PS5 vs PS4/other) or any UK-specific markings, nor any clear storage size or power-on/boot status.

risks.risk: Wrong model/version (e.g., not PS5 “fat”), which changes value significantly.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console’s model number label (e.g., on the back/bottom) and the exact version text/branding visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-confidence PlayStation console shown (not confirmed PS5 fat), with unknown storage and unknown performance.

risks.risk: Not tested: may not power on, may fail to boot, or may have hardware faults.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on and booting to the home screen (with the console staying on).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until it boots successfully.

risks.risk: Controller issues (drift, unresponsive buttons, bad ports, charging problems).
risks.proof: A video showing controller connected and working in menus (moving sticks, pressing buttons) plus a close-up of ports and charging cable/charging indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown; assume possible faults.

risks.risk: Missing or faulty accessories/cables (power/HDMI/stand), which affects usability and resale.
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing all included items: power cable, HDMI cable, stand, and any other accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the console + controller are included (cables/accessories not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Disc drive status unknown (if it’s a disc model): may not read discs or may be noisy.
risks.proof: A video clip inserting a disc and showing it being read/playing (or a clear test screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as disc drive unverified (or assume disc drive may be unreliable).

risks.risk: Cosmetic/thermal condition unknown (overheating signs, heavy scratches/dents, fan noise).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of vents/underside and a short clip of the fan running during gameplay/idle.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic/thermal condition for an unverified unit.

risks.risk: Account/bans/previous ownership issues (if applicable) affecting usability and warranty/service eligibility.
risks.proof: Photos of system settings showing account status and any ban/console restrictions (or a factory reset confirmation).
risks.if_unproven: Price as account status unknown; assume potential restrictions.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model number label (back/bottom) showing exact version (PS5 fat vs other) and region/UK markings if present.
Short video: power on and boot to the PlayStation home screen.
Video: controller connected and fully responsive in menus (stick movement + button presses).
Photos of included accessories laid out (power cable, HDMI, stand, headset/box if any).
If disc model: video inserting a disc and showing it reads/plays.
Close-ups of vents/underside plus a short clip showing fan noise/thermals during idle or a game.
Photo of system settings/account status and confirmation of factory reset (or any restriction messages).
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a white PlayStation console with a controller, but the key details needed to price it correctly (exact model/version, storage, power-on/boot, controller health, and included accessories) are not shown. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
